title: Stalk comparison for the actual affine double dual
statement:
theorem affine_double_dual_stalk
    (A : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsNoetherianRing A] (M : ModuleCat.{u} A)
    [Module.Finite A M] (x : Spec A) :
    ∃ hfinite : Module.Finite ((Spec A).presheaf.stalk x)
        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) (tilde M).val.presheaf x),
      letI := hfinite
      Nonempty
        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
            (tilde (ModuleCat.of A (Module.Dual A (Module.Dual A M)))).val.presheaf x
          ≃ₗ[(Spec A).presheaf.stalk x]
            Module.Dual ((Spec A).presheaf.stalk x)
              (Module.Dual ((Spec A).presheaf.stalk x)
                (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) (tilde M).val.presheaf x)))

proof.text: Equip the structure stalk with its canonical A-algebra structure. Use the associated-sheaf toStalk localization map; localization of finite modules proves finiteness of the stalk of tilde M.

For a finite module over a Noetherian ring, finite presentation makes the localized map on Hom into the local ring a module localization. Its universal property gives a linear equivalence from the stalk of the dual sheaf to the local dual of the stalk. Extend scalars on this equivalence to the structure stalk. Apply twice and compose with the inverse transpose of the first equivalence.
